description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Unlucky Cabbage Merchant triggers twice. Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Unlucky Cabbage Merchant.
Resolve the first Unlucky Cabbage Merchant trigger, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Food token.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the remaining Unlucky Cabbage Merchant trigger.
Repeat from step 1.
